map.斜接角和锯台设置角有什么区别？: What is the difference between the mitre angle and the saw table setting?
map.斜接角是每段木料端面相对拼接中线的夹角，决定转角是否严丝合缝；锯台设置角是斜切锯: The mitre angle is the angle of each piece's end face relative to the joint centre line, which decides whether the corner closes tightly; the saw table setting is the rotation of the mitre saw table from perpendicular, equal to 90° minus the mitre angle. Both describe the same cut, only from different reference bases.
map.复合斜切为什么输入角度不等于实际切割角？: Why is the entered angle not equal to the actual cut angle in a compound mitre?
map.复合斜切同时含斜接与斜切两个分量，木料在倾斜状态下投影到水平/垂直面后角度变小。: A compound mitre contains both a mitre and a bevel component; once the stock is tilted, the angles projected onto the horizontal and vertical planes become smaller. For example, with a mitre of 45° and a bevel of 30°, the actual mitre angle is about 40.89° and the actual bevel angle about 20.70°, and these two converted values must be used to set the saw.
map.锥切的锥度比 1:30 是什么意思？: What does a taper ratio of 1:30 mean?
map.锥度比 = 宽度差 ÷ 长度。1:30 表示每 30mm 长度上宽度收窄 1mm: Taper ratio = width difference ÷ length. 1:30 means the width narrows by 1 mm over every 30 mm of length. The single-sided taper angle = arctan(width difference / 2 ÷ length), and setting the saw table to the single-sided taper angle completes the taper cut.
map.先把斜接角 ma 与斜切角 ba 由度转弧度（× π ÷ 180）。实际斜接角: First convert the miter angle ma and bevel angle ba from degrees to radians (× π ÷ 180). Actual miter angle = arctan(tan(ma) × cos(ba)) converted back to degrees; actual bevel angle = arcsin(sin(ba) × cos(ma)) converted back to degrees; true cutting angle = arctan(tan(ma) ÷ cos(ba)) converted back to degrees; the sum ma + ba is also given for reference

map.段数为什么会改变示意图却不改变角度？: Why does the segment count change the preview but not the angle?
map.段数只用于画出 N 段正多边形示意，帮助理解拼接形态；多边形内角不等于输入的接头: The segment count only draws an N-segment regular polygon to show the joint form; its interior angle is not the entered joint angle. Use the per-side miter and saw setting on the left. Compound mode rejects blank values or ≥89° because of the tangent singularity.
